climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A warm, dry Central Coast AVA in the Santa Lucia Range of Monterey County, around Lake San Antonio. Gravelly loam and clay soils and a climate like Paso Robles suit full-bodied Rhône and Bordeaux grapes, and more than 20 varieties are grown.
